subject: Quality bridge: promptset deployment gating and fallback checklist
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quality bridge: promptset deployment gating and fallback checklist

Morning all —

Putting this thread together to align cross‑functionally on the promptset_v3 rollout for Acme Health (their pilot next week). Main goal: we need an explicit gating & fallback playbook so Product, Evals, and QA are clear on acceptance criteria and automatic rollback behavior if we see quality regressions. High level asks: 

- Marissa: confirm the A/B acceptance criteria and what exact eval sets we will run in staging (slice definitions + pass/fail thresholds). See attached ab_plan_v2.xlsx.
- Markus: confirm staging capacity and metrics we can surface in the Console during the canary (latency P95, per-route token cost, model confidence proxy, and per‑class error rates).
- Karthik: confirm whether product is okay with a progressive rollout by account region (US first, EU hold until we validate privacy telemetry) and whether the SLA behavior in the canary needs special exceptions.

Proposed gating thresholds (draft):
- Quality delta (primary metric, promptset baseline -> v3): no more than 1.5 percentage points absolute drop on the weighted NPS-like acceptance metric across top 10 intents.
- Safety regressions: zero new high‑severity policy hits (blocklisted outputs) across 10k canary requests.
- Latency: P95 increase <= 80ms relative to baseline.

Fallback: automatic pin to promptset_v2 if any of the above triggers fire; manual review window 30m. We should also document the owner for the manual unblock.

Attachments: promptset_v3.json (prompt artifacts), ab_plan_v2.xlsx (eval matrix), canary_playbook.md (playbook skeleton).

Can we get short confirmations + any modifications by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quality bridge: promptset deployment gating and fallback checklist

Thanks Camila — this is helpful. Quick responses and clarifications from Evals: 

1) Eval slices: we'll run the staged A/B on the following prompt slices in staging: top10 intents (by volume), low-frequency warranty/edge case prompts, and a safety probe set (internal blocklist + adversarial fuzzers). Full list in attached promptset_v3.json comments.

2) Acceptance criteria: I agree with the 1.5pp primary threshold but propose we add a secondary tolerance window: if delta is between 1.5pp and 2.5pp, we enter a brief quarantine (halt rollout, expand samples to 50k requests, run targeted human review). Only >2.5pp would trigger immediate auto‑rollback. This gives us a more graduated response and fewer false positives from statistical noise.

3) Measurement cadence & tooling: we'll publish a daily signal and an hourly lightweight-sampler metric during the first 48h of canary. Metrics we need instrumented in Console: per‑intent confusion matrix, 95th token latency, and per‑bucket safety hits.

Open risk: our current eval harness undercounts conversational multi‑turn drift for the low-frequency prompts. If we go live too quickly, we could miss pragmatic regressions. I recommend we run a 24h multi‑turn replay prior to full production rollout. That will add a day to schedule — okay if product can absorb it.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead, Evals & Quality

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quality bridge: promptset deployment gating and fallback checklist

Agree with the approach. A few product notes: 

- Progressive rollout by region is preferred (US => EU => APAC). For EU we need to gate on privacy telemetry parity (confirm that telemetry we collect for evals is compliant with Acme's DPA). Nimbus compliance will need to sign off.
- SLA exceptions: for the canary window we can allow a temporary latency SLO relaxation for affected routes provided we call it out in the contract addendum. I'll coordinate the messaging with Legal.
- Timing: I can accept the 24h multi‑turn replay but ask that we limit the expanded human review to a single prioritized intent list to keep turnaround fast.

I'll notify Acme's PM (Sarah) that we may push the pilot by 24h if the multi‑turn job is required.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Group Product Manager

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quality bridge: promptset deployment gating and fallback checklist

Staging & infra notes: 

- Capacity: we have a dedicated staging pool for this pilot (8x A100 equivalent). We can run the 24h multi‑turn replay overnight without impacting other teams, but the job will consume reserve capacity and we should lock the window.
- Metrics we can surface in Console in near real‑time: latency P50/P95/P99, per‑route token cost, throughput, and a safety hit stream. I will wire up per‑intent confusion deltas to the existing eval dashboards; expect a prototype by tomorrow noon.
- Auto‑fallback: we can implement a short circuit that pins routes to promptset_v2 when the safety or >2.5pp quality trigger fires. We can execute the pin via the rollout config; the manual unblock will be owned by "Evals Lead" (Marissa) with Product (Karthik) as secondary approver.

I'll attach a small playbook (canary_playbook.md) with runbook steps and observability links.

Markus

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quality bridge: promptset deployment gating and fallback checklist

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Summary / action items I will track: 

- Marissa: finalize eval slice definitions and publish the detailed acceptance doc in the Google Doc (link above) by EOD tomorrow. Also prepare the prioritized intent list for any expanded human review.
- Markus: complete wiring of per‑intent deltas to Console and confirm the staging window Monday 22 Jul for the 24h multi‑turn replay. Share canary_playbook.md + runbook links.
- Karthik: confirm EU telemetry gating language with Nimbus Compliance and Legal; flag any contract wording changes. Also tell Acme PM (Sarah) about the potential 24h shift.
- Camila (me): I'll update the pilot timeline, notify Acme, and schedule a 30m cross‑functional kickoff 1h before the canary begins.

If there are no objections I will close this thread and create the final rollout RFC.

–Camila
(Attachments referenced: promptset_v3.json (artifact), ab_plan_v2.xlsx (eval matrix), canary_playbook.md (runbook), staging-metrics-spec.yaml (metrics spec))
